s1: This is Bexley. One pool of NEAR, split into two tokens. bee-ex USD holds one dollar, and earns. ex-NEAR is leveraged NEAR, with no liquidations.
s2: You deposit NEAR, and pick a side. Every mint happens at fair value, so nobody else's position moves.
s3: Your portfolio shows everything you hold, in dollars. Your tokens, savings, vaults and orders. And exactly how much it moves, when NEAR moves.
s4: Or just ask. Bexley's AI, running on NEAR AI, turns plain English into a plan, with the result and the main risk. Nothing happens until you approve it.
s5: An AI Guardian runs the pool every five minutes. It sets fees and the savings rate inside hard limits, with a key that can't move funds. Every decision is signed inside NEAR AI's secure hardware, and your browser checks the proof.
s6: We tested it. We pushed NEAR down thirty-seven percent. The safety rails slowed the fall. The AI raised fees. At a hundred and twenty-five percent backing, the Stability Pool stepped in, and lifted it back to a hundred and forty. bee-ex USD held one dollar, the whole time.
s7: And with NEAR Intents, you can bring USDC, ETH, SOL, or Bitcoin from other chains, straight into Bexley. No bridging.
s8: Bexley. Double the possibilities, from one pool. Built on NEAR.
